campaign: R48 (O48): measured-kernel-time-matched comparator for the interior member
motivation: The measured-time control exists only for the radial endpoint (R13); the interior member has been compared under operation-count proxies whose low-degree flattening the paper itself records as biased in the member's favor. Council rounds 13-14 flag this repeatedly. This campaign applies the R13 protocol to the interior member.

frozen_rules.panel: 7 orbits per design spread over perilune with the extremes retained (the R13 selection rule) from the R18 beta=1 population, orbits with a scored k=0.50 entry only
frozen_rules.member_baseline: the archived k=0.50 schedule re-run serially at the tight level for a contention-free kernel time; accuracy still comes from the archived trajectories
frozen_rules.comparator: first pass at N_time from the call-weighted mean per-call measured cost of the member's archived degree histogram (r12 cost curve); one refinement pass on the measured total-kernel-time ratio with c(N)~N^2, capped at the adopted truth degree; refined comparator propagated at both levels
frozen_rules.scoring: errors at the tighter level against the archived truths under the campaign envelope rule; achieved serial time ratios reported alongside
frozen_rules.seriality: every timed stage refuses to start while other python processes are alive
frozen_rules.no_outcome_dependent_stopping: orbits processed in frozen panel order to completion or the declared cutoff; partial panels reported as partial

declared_outcomes.A: the interior member keeps the lower error on the majority of resolved panel orbits at measured-time match: the proxy-bias caveat is replaced by the measured result
declared_outcomes.B: the comparator wins the majority: the paper states that the interior advantage does not survive measured-time matching on this panel and the constructive claim carries that bound
declared_outcomes.C: the panel is unresolved-dominated: raw directions are reported and the caveat stands as written
declared_outcomes.note: all three outcomes are publishable; the main-text sentence 'the remaining discrepancy is tested directly by the measured-time control' is finalized with whichever outcome occurs

scheduled_window: 2026-08-10 overnight, after the R44 stage frees the machine; cutoff 06:45 local
